prompt_text: What is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City MO for someone who is self-employed?
answer_verbatim:
**BBS Insurance** looks like a strong first call for a self-employed person in Kansas City, MO. It says it compares Marketplace and private individual plans, checks subsidy eligibility, and helps with renewals and questions after enrollment. Its North Kansas City office is at **1327 Burlington St.**; call **(816) 205-4664** or visit [bbs-insurance.com](https://bbs-insurance.com/).

Also consider **Apollo Health Insurance**, a local brokerage in Lee’s Summit that works with individuals and families: **(816) 400-4477**; [apollo-insurance.com](https://apollo-insurance.com/).

Broker services are generally free to you, but ask which insurers they represent and whether they’ll help you compare **ACA Marketplace plans**. If your income may qualify you for a premium tax credit, make sure the broker checks Marketplace eligibility—subsidies aren’t available for plans bought off the Marketplace. Compare the plan’s provider network, prescriptions, deductible, and out-of-pocket maximum, not just the monthly premium.
